source: NASA CR-183200 / Pratt & Whitney FR-19435-1, RL10A-3-3B High Mixture Ratio Qualification Program, Table V-7, Engine XR403-2. https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19910004173
author: T. Vogel; D. Varella; C. Smith
conditions: RL10A-3-3B qualification test, engine XR403-2; six run-level mixture-ratio/Isp pairs transcribed from Table V-7. Test series 1985–1986. Table V-7 performance conditions vary by run; this is not a single-condition controlled sweep.
uncertainty: Per-point Isp uncertainty is not reported alongside these six transcribed rows; UNKNOWN. The report separately states a nominal RL10A-3-3B specific impulse of 436.0 ± 2.7 s at mixture ratio 6.0.

author: R. W. Marable
